test_title: PYST 15: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 11 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the primary objective of the NPS Vatsalya scheme launched in 2024?

options.text: To replace the existing National Pension System (NPS) for all age groups
To support pension benefits for unorganised sector workers
To offer a savings-cum-pension plan exclusively for minors
To provide old-age pension to senior citizens living in rural areas

solution:
The correct answer is __**To offer a savings-cum-pension plan exclusively for minors**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **NPS Vatsalya scheme** launched in 2024 aims to provide a savings-cum-pension plan exclusively for minors.
 
• The scheme is designed to encourage early financial planning and long-term savings for children.
 
• It offers benefits such as systematic contributions and accumulated funds for future financial needs of minors.
 
• Parents or guardians can enroll minors into the scheme, ensuring financial security and a robust savings structure for their children.
 
• The scheme aligns with the government’s initiative to promote financial literacy and savings habit among younger generations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Pension System (NPS):**

 
 
• NPS is a government-backed pension scheme launched in 2004 for employees and extended to all citizens in 2009.
 
• It allows systematic savings during an individual's working life, providing financial stability post-retirement.
 
• The scheme operates under the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA).
 
• Subscribers can invest in various asset classes like equity, government securities, and corporate bonds.
 
 
 
• **Savings-cum-Pension Plans:**
 
 
• These are hybrid financial products combining savings with pension benefits.
 
• Subscribers can accumulate funds during their earning years and receive periodic pension payments post-retirement.
 
• Such plans are essential for long-term financial security and addressing future financial needs.
 
 
 
• **Financial Literacy:**
 
 
• It refers to the understanding and effective use of financial skills like budgeting, investing, and saving.
 
• Promoting financial literacy among minors is crucial to developing responsible financial habits early in life.
 
 
 
• **Government Initiatives for Minors:**
 
 
• The government has launched several schemes targeting minors, including Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana and Bal Vikas Savings Plans.
 
• These initiatives aim to secure the future of children and promote savings habits within families.
